plain_description: Gemma gives you Google-grade open-weights LLMs to build AI into your products without vendor lock-in. It handles multi-modal conversations combining text and images and can be fine-tuned on your own data. Runs on your own infrastructure with no external API dependency.
technical_description: Gemma is a JAX-based library for using and fine-tuning Google DeepMind's family of open-weights large language models. The Python package provides a ChatSampler API for multi-turn, multi-modal conversations and supports fine-tuning via LoRA adapters. Models are available in multiple sizes (2B to 7B+) and run on CPU, GPU, or TPU hardware. Includes Colab notebooks for sampling, multi-modal inference, and fine-tuning workflows.
title: Gemma
